includes: Top of the line rod and reels
blurb: Guests fish or cruise on a 46’ deadrise style fishing boat called Bay Eagle, accommodating up to 30 passengers. Trips fish the waters of Chesapeake Bay from Tolchester Beach to Chesapeake Beach MD. Fishing methods include trolling, chumming, live lining, and bottom fishing targeting species like rockfish, red drum, spot, perch, croaker, bluefish, and Spanish mackerel.
extraNote: $200 deposit required to hold reservation · $90 additional fee per person over 6 passengers · Mate works for tips only, customarily 20% · WP Nautical marina (Trumpy Yard), next to the Chart House restaurant
